title: FLA import: frame label anchor type never decoded — always mapped to name/comment
description: In flash8-binary.ts, the FLA binary decoder tracks labelIsComment: boolean but has no labelIsAnchor field. flash8-import.ts line 1026 maps: f.labelIsComment ? 'comment' : 'name' — the 'anchor' type is never produced from FLA import. The SWF encoding side already supports anchor labels (encodeFrameLabel with isAnchor=true), but they're never created by the importer. Fix: in flash8-binary.ts CPicFrame reading, find where labelType/labelIsComment is decoded (the byte that distinguishes name vs comment vs anchor) and also extract the anchor flag. Add labelIsAnchor?: boolean to Fla8Frame. In flash8-import.ts, map to 'anchor' when appropriate.
